Trieste — Rome, Italy

Average day Average night

In detail

Trieste is an upscale residential quarter around Corso Trieste and Piazza Istria, adjoining Salario and Villa Ada. Local press has documented several armed robberies at pharmacies in the area, including a December 2024 incident at a pharmacy near Piazza Istria where a shot was fired and an employee was injured, and a separate case in which a pharmacist was robbed and briefly held at his home. Coverage suggests these are targeted commercial robberies rather than general street danger, but the repeated armed nature of the incidents warrants caution around these specific businesses.
